main_results.scope: GROW–information bound for arbitrary subfamilies of tilted laws on an open exponential-moment domain; extended logarithms permit zero e-variables.

Gaussian boundary conclusion for centered measures with symmetric positive definite covariance and bounded open neighborhoods of zero in positive dimension; the inverse precision operator is constructed.

Raywise-convex first-exit propagation for arbitrary open neighborhoods of zero.
Finite priors on optimal support, exact KL identity, quadratic error, and weak convergence; corollary_4_4_map gives the linear-plus-quadratic map bound.
